rights.redistribution_scope: Compact factual address-match results only; no third-party map tiles or imagery are included.

coordinate_semantics: Each point is the longitude and latitude returned for an exact-address Match under the Census Public_AR_Current benchmark. Census address matching may use street-range interpolation. The point is used only as an address locator for the source-linked parent campus; it is never a parcel, building, campus boundary, project footprint, construction extent, entrance, survey point, or site centroid.
